begin SothaLine10

short doonce

if(GetDistance, Player <= 256)
	if(doonce == 0)
		Player->say  "vo\Sotha\SothaLine10.mp3""Be wary, mortal. I am not... fully in control, here. Everything is failing, it seems, and should that lift fail you will be beyond my assistance."
		set doonce to 1
	endif
endif

end

begin SothaLine11

float timer

if(GetDistance, Player <= 256)
	if(Sotha_Nere == 0)
		DisablePlayerControls
		Player->say  "vo\Sotha\SothaLine11.mp3" "I feared that would happen. Mortal, there is an ancillary lift on the far side of the complex. Make your way there as quickly as you can. Stop for absolutely nothing. This floor is extremely unsta-"
		set Sotha_Nere to 1
	endif
endif

if(Sotha_Nere == 1)
	set timer to (timer + getSecondsPassed)
	if(timer >= 13)
		if(Sotha_Nere <= 1)
			EnablePlayerControls
			PlaySound "sotha_nerevarline1"
			MessageBox "You thought you could fool me, didn't you? Fraudulent deceiver! The Dwemer are crafty, and seek ever to unbalance the perfect order of Resdayn! My advisors warned me. They said a look-alike would come, and here you are. You shall not survive!" 
			set Sotha_Nere to 2
		endif
	endif
endif

end

begin SothaLine12

short doonce

if(GetDistance, Player <= 256)
	if(doonce == 0)
		Player->say  "vo\Sotha\SothaLine12.mp3""Through that doorway is the Fabricant manufactory. It has been corrupted, and is completely beyond my control. I would advise you not to enter, as you would most likely be torn to pieces by rogue Fabricants."
		set doonce to 1
	endif
endif

end

begin SothaLine13

short doonce

if(GetDistance, Player <= 256)
	if(doonce == 0)
		Player->say  "vo\Sotha\SothaLine13.mp3""So, you've chosen to disregard my advice and enter. Stupid of you. Very well, then. I shall channel your stupidity to a constructive end. I would have you repair this portion of the City. You must rebuild the two portions of the foundry, that which created life, and the other, which created machine."
		set doonce to 1
	endif
endif

end

begin SothaLine14

short doonce

if(GetDistance, Player <= 256)
	if(doonce == 0)
		Player->say  "vo\Sotha\SothaLine14.mp3""Thank you, mortal, for aiding me in this endeavor. I had feared the permanent loss of my foundry, but you have exceeded my expectations and aided me considerably. Now you may come to the City proper, meet its citizenry, and rest. You are now a citizen of Sotha Sil for your exemplary service, as a formality, you should speak with the Archcanon. Should I have further need of you, you will know."
		set doonce to 1
	endif
endif

end

begin SothaLine15

short doonce
float timer

if(GetDistance, Player <= 256)
	if(doonce == 0)
		Player->say  "vo\Sotha\SothaLine15.mp3""That, mortal, is the Imperfect. The Clockwork God was as vulnerable to imperfection as all else is, and so He created it, His finest work, as a monument to and grave of the faults He left behind."
		set doonce to 1
	endif
endif

if(doonce == 1)
	set timer to (timer + getSecondsPassed)
	if(timer >= 23)
		if(doonce <= 1)
			Player->say  "vo\Sotha\SothaLine16.mp3""It acted as his closest guardian, but it has gone mad, Imperfection given form without Perfection to restrain it. It is the being that has caused the ruin of my city, and I would have you kill him, mortal, though he deserves it not. He has acted from madness rather than malice, but he must be destroyed for the good of the City."
			set doonce to 2
			endif
	endif
endif

end

begin SothaLine17

short doonce

if(GetDistance, Player <= 256)
	if(doonce == 0)
		Player->say  "vo\Sotha\SothaLine17.mp3""You are approaching the heart of this city, mortal, though it lies dark and empty. There is no movement, and it beats no longer. Make haste! Greater powers conspire against you, and malfunctions abound. Take care. It would be ill-suited for the hero to die just before their moment of triumph."
		set doonce to 1
	endif
endif

end

begin SothaLine4

short doonce

if(GetDistance, Player <= 256)
	if(doonce == 0)
		Player->say  "vo\Sotha\SothaLine4.mp3""Oh, well done. You've managed to survive. Truly impressive. But, what are you, you ask me. I can hear the thought buzzing about you, nipping at the back of your mind. I am Gestalt, regent of the Clockwork City. I need no other name."

short doonce

begin SothaLine7

short doonce

if(GetDistance, Player <= 256)
	if(doonce == 0)
		Player->say  "vo\Sotha\SothaLine7.mp3""It is a fundamental truth of our world that all things regress from the divine. These rooms and corridors, flooded, rusting, and decayed, provide all the proof of that axiom any mer could need. It is said that the Dwemer, in their folly, and the Altmer, in their arrogance, sought and seek to reverse this, the most constant of laws. In their sin, I am no different."
		set doonce to 1
	endif
endif

end

begin SothaLine9_1

short doonce
float timer
short activate

if(GetDistance, Player <= 256)
	set activate to 1
endif

if(activate == 1)
	set timer to (timer + GetSecondsPassed)
	if(timer > 3)
		if(doonce == 0)
			PlaySound "SothaLever"
			set Sotha_AntiDoor to 1
			Player->say  "vo\Sotha\SothaLine9_1.mp3" "I've opened a path, flee!"
			set doonce to 1
		endif
	endif
endif

end

begin SothaLine9_2

short activate
short doonce
float timer
short sound

if(GetDistance, Player <= 256)
	set activate to 1
endif

if(activate == 1)
	if(sound == 0)
			set sound to 1
			Player->say  "vo\Sotha\SothaLine9_2.mp3" "A mark of wisdom is knowing when you're outmatched, and a mark of a survivor is awareness of one's surroundings."
	endif	
	set timer to (timer + GetSecondsPassed)
	if(timer > 2)
		if(doonce == 0)
			PlaySound "SothaLever"
			set Sotha_AntiDoor to 2
			set doonce to 1
		endif
	endif
endif


end

Begin sotharemovespellscript

short hasSpell1
short hasSpell2
short hasSpell3
short hasSpell4


if(MenuMode == 1)
	return
endif


set hasSpell1 to ( player->GetSpellEffects, "sotha_sehtjumping" )
set hasSpell2 to ( player->GetSpellEffects, "sotha_sehtsneaking" )
set hasSpell3 to ( player->GetSpellEffects, "sotha_sehtrunning" )
set hasSpell4 to ( player->GetSpellEffects, "sotha_swimming" )


if ( player->HasItemEquipped, sotha_sothalegs == 0 )
	if(hasSpell1 == 1)
		player-> removespell "sotha_sehtjumping"
	endif
	if(hasSpell2 == 1)
		player-> removespell "sotha_sehtsneaking"
	endif
	if(hasSpell3 == 1)
		player-> removespell "sotha_sehtrunning"
	endif
	if(hasSpell4 == 1)
		player-> removespell "sotha_swimming"
	endif
endif




end

begin Sound_SothaFactory4

	set swingTime to 1

	set timer to ( timer + GetSecondsPassed )

	;rotate up

			PlaySound "sotha_factory1"

endif

begin SSE_SothaSil

short state
short doOnce

if ( menumode == 1 )
	return
endif

;this part sets the weather back to normal after endgame

if ( GetJournalIndex SSE_Endgame>= 40 )
	if ( doOnce == 0 )
		ModRegion "Mournhold Region" 25 35 5 20 10 5 0 0
		ChangeWeather "Mournhold Region" 1
		set doOnce to 1
	endif
endif

;this part sets up endgame
if ( OnActivate == 1 )
	if ( sotha_state == 0 )
		messagebox "You have found the body of Sotha Sil, his lifeless hulk dangling from a contraption of his own making. Someone has obviously been here before you." "Ok"
		Journal, SSE_Endgame, 10
		set sotha_state to 1	
	endif
endif


end

Begin TribunalMain

short disablestate
short newstate

;by default, enable teleport and levitate
set newstate to 0

;only need to check cells in interiors
if ( GetInterior )
	if ( GetPCCell "Sotha Sil," == 1 )
		;disable teleport and levitate here
		set newstate to 1
	elseif ( GetPCCell "Mournhold" == 1 )
		;disable levitate only here
		set newstate to 2
	endif
endif

;if state should change
if ( disablestate != newstate )
	if ( newstate == 1 )
		DisableTeleporting
		DisableLevitation
	elseif ( newstate == 2 )
		DisableLevitation
	elseif ( newstate == 0 )
		EnableTeleporting
		EnableLevitation
	endif
	set disablestate to newstate
endif

end
